pieces.Text: As a standard action, you can unleash a ball of energy that explodes in a 5-foot radius burst dealing
d4 points of fire damage. A successful Reflex save (DC
) halves this damage. This attack has a range of 60 feet. You can fire
explosive ball(s) per day. You can fire more than one ball at a time, but creatures caught inside more than one simultaneous explosions only take damage once.
